name: Autoplay Dex Bot
author: OpenAI Codex
description: Adds a pausable in-game autoplay bot that uses virtual inputs, scans maps/events, follows guide objectives, and tracks dex progress.
This first release is intentionally conservative: it can plan, explore, battle with existing AI, catch needed species, and pause for manual takeover when uncertain.

settings.label: Runtime Hooks
settings.description: Allows the bot runtime and hotkey to run while this mod is loaded.

settings.label: Autostart
settings.description: Starts the bot automatically. Off means press the pause key to start or resume.

settings.label: Pause Key
settings.description: Key used to start, pause, and resume the bot.

settings.label: Bot Overlay
settings.description: Compact HUD is a lightweight always-on bot status panel. Classic Window uses the older Pokemon text window. Off hides bot status UI.

settings.label: Auto Exclusive Choices
settings.description: On: randomly picks one-time choices like starters. Off: pauses so the player can choose.

settings.label: Route Profile
settings.description: Routing assumption used by the objective planner.

settings.label: Automation Scope
settings.description: Wild Capture Focus keeps autonomy small and reliable: find nearby grass, catch needed Pokemon, and handle battles. Story Explorer enables the broader story/frontier planner.

settings.label: Guide Pack
settings.description: Human-editable guide pack used for story objectives.

settings.label: Prime Objective
settings.description: Top-level mission for autonomous play. Living Dex + Fusions keeps story progress pointed toward unlocking every collectible Pokemon and fusion.

settings.label: Completion Scope
settings.description: How broadly the bot treats unlocked routes, regions, and modded content as required progression.

settings.label: Dex Copies
settings.description: How hard the bot tries to keep duplicate base species for fusions.

settings.label: Rare Policy
settings.description: How the bot handles rare encounters before leaving an area.

settings.label: Nicknames
settings.description: Controls whether the bot nicknames newly obtained Pokemon.

settings.label: Trainer Capture
settings.description: Controls bot use of Kuray Rocket Mode trainer steals. Respect Game follows the save's Rocket Mode option.

settings.label: Team Strategy
settings.description: Controls caught Pokemon party/storage decisions and roster scoring.

settings.label: Fusion Strategy
settings.description: Records safe fusion recommendations for the bot's progression team without consuming last dex copies.

settings.label: Fusion Collection
settings.description: Own Each Seen Fusion makes unseen wild/static/trainer-stealable fusions count as capture targets, while still protecting last base copies.

settings.label: Recovery
settings.description: Controls whether normal bot confusion becomes a recoverable route objective or a manual pause.

settings.label: Train After Loss
settings.description: After a blackout from a major fight, heal, train nearby, and retry instead of immediately repeating the same loss.

settings.label: Frontier Explore
settings.description: Allows the bot to explore scanned unknown or modded transfers with bounded retries.

settings.label: Safe Mode
settings.description: Prioritizes known story rails and delays optional frontier cleanup on large outdoor/story maps to reduce lockups.

settings.label: Local Discovery
settings.description: While following story rails, detours for nearby reachable items, resource spots, NPCs, and buildings before walking past them.

settings.label: Discovery Radius
settings.description: How far the bot may detour for local items, NPCs, and buildings before continuing the current story route.

settings.label: Autonomy Profile
settings.description: Controls how strongly the scheduler favors collector cleanup versus story momentum.

settings.label: Map Clear Policy
settings.description: Queue Opportunistic records every scanned target, clears nearby work, and returns later for expensive cleanup.

settings.label: Collector Intensity
settings.description: Controls duplicate catching, resource restocking, and bounded cleanup eagerness.

settings.label: Adaptive Planner
settings.description: Allows short low-lag pathfinding bursts for recovery, interactables, healer routes, and transfers.

settings.label: Resources
settings.description: Controls how the bot restocks supplies. Legit Shop Flow only buys through shops the bot has reached normally.

settings.label: Hunt Goal
settings.description: Controls which dex targets the hunt-first loop prioritizes.

settings.label: Hunt Unlocks
settings.description: Controls how much story/explorer movement the bot uses after a zone stops producing useful encounters.

settings.label: Zone Budget
settings.description: Controls how long the bot samples a zone before trying a better known area or conservative unlock path.

settings.label: World Coverage
settings.description: Lets the bot build a persistent map atlas and use story unlocks, transfers, NPCs, trainers, and items as world-level goals.

settings.label: Story Unlocks First
settings.description: Prioritizes story progress when it opens routes, towns, HMs, shops, fast travel, or encounter zones.

settings.label: Backtracking
settings.description: Controls whether the world atlas may route back to earlier maps for cleanup after new paths open.

settings.label: Wild Rocket Balls
settings.description: Controls whether Rocket Balls may ever be used on wild Pokemon.

settings.label: Ball Floor
settings.description: Minimum non-Rocket balls the bot tries to keep for dex hunting.

settings.label: Heal Floor
settings.description: Minimum healing items the bot tries to keep before extended hunting.

settings.label: Repeatable Battles
settings.description: Controls how the bot learns repeatable trainer battles.

settings.label: Farming
settings.description: Controls when the bot uses repeatable battles for XP or money.

settings.label: Farm Cycles
settings.description: Caps repeatable battle farming before the bot returns to the current story objective.

settings.label: Money Reserve
settings.description: Minimum cash the bot tries to keep after shopping.

settings.label: Resource Overlay
settings.description: Controls whether resource needs appear in the bot overlay.

settings.label: Learning Logs
settings.description: Records soft failures, manual pauses, stuck loops, and crash-adjacent states so future planning can avoid repeating them.

settings.label: Menu Escape
settings.description: If the bot sits in a menu too long without making progress, it assumes the menu should be closed and continues play.

settings.label: Menu Timeout
settings.description: Frames to wait before backing out of an idle menu. 600 is about ten seconds at 60 FPS.

settings.label: Objective Retries
settings.description: How many soft recovery retries the bot should attempt before treating an objective as failed frontier work.

settings.label: Planner Budget
settings.description: Controls scanner/pathfinder aggressiveness. Low Lag favors known rails and small bursts.

settings.label: Debug Escape
settings.description: Reserved for future QA-only recovery. V1 does not use debug warps.
